Priya (Finance): heads up — saw ~ $12,400 GPU charge in us-west2 on Sat 02:30 UTC that's not tagged to any team. :eyes:
Jordan (ML Infra): yikes. any sample project_id or trace?
Priya (Finance): billing shows project `redwood-prod-ml-002` but no labels. waveform looks like continuous 8h run, preemptible N2+T4s.
Samir (Platform): @Jordan can you check job names? Might be the nightly retrain.
Jordan (ML Infra): checking logs now. Quick grep of airflow shows a `retrain-neon_v2` DAG ran 18:12 PST sat. PID: neon-retrain-2026-03-21-1812
Ana (Research): we did kick an experiment last week (neon hypersearch) but we requested spot-only notebooks with tag `team:neon`. not sure why it dropped tag.
Maya (Ops): finance-bot created alert INC-3456 (unallocated-gpu-surge).
finance-bot: Alert INC-3456 created for untagged GPU spend > $10k in us-west2. See /incidents/INC-3456
Priya (Finance): can someone run a quick BQ query to list top VM instances by cost for that window?
Jordan (ML Infra): here's the snippet I used:
```
SELECT resource.labels.instance_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM `billing.gcp_costs`
WHERE project.id = 'redwood-prod-ml-002'
  AND usage_start_time BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2026-03-21T02:00:00Z') AND TIMESTAMP('2026-03-21T10:00:00Z')
GROUP BY instance_id
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Samir (Platform): top line items point to vm `rt-neon-34` and `rt-neon-35` — both in the notebook pool. Those should have label `team:neon` but label is empty.
Ana (Research): that matches — my script launched via a helper that didn't pass through label flags for multi-node trials. my mistake.
Priya (Finance): ok, next steps: 1) tag retroactively for chargeback (finance + infra), 2) backfill tags in billing exports so attribution fixes, 3) docs update to require label enforcement at launch.
Maya (Ops): I'll open a cloud task to patch instance metadata and trigger a backfill job. ETA 4h.
Jordan (ML Infra): I'll add a pre-launch check in the orchestration: fail if `team` label missing. small PR coming.
Samir (Platform): we should also add a nightly audit that alerts on untagged high-cost VMs.
Priya (Finance): finance wants a short note for the CXS team — possible chargeback or internal transfer of ~$12.4k to Research/Neon. Can you confirm exact amount after backfill?
Ana (Research): will confirm once Ops backfill completes, likely tomorrow morning.
Priya (Finance): cool. Marking as action items: @Maya backfill, @Jordan enforce label, @Ana confirm experiment owner. I'll hold chargeback until we have final numbers. :+1:
Maya (Ops): backfill job kicked — job id bf-7783. I'll post completion in this thread.
finance-bot: INC-3456 status updated -> in_progress (owner: Maya).
Priya (Finance): thanks all. small follow-up: please add the experiment run id to billing description for future ease (e.g., `run=neon-hyper-20260321`).
Ana (Research): noted, will update launcher.
Maya (Ops): backfill completed. Results attached to INC-3456. Backfilled cost attribution shows $12,378.40 moved to `team:neon`.
finance-bot: INC-3456 status updated -> resolved.
Priya (Finance): confirmed. closing thread. will log transfer in the ledger and notify accounting. Thanks everyone.
